d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Indian-Americans Amish Shah in Arizona and Pia Dandiya in Florida are contesting key US House of Representatives races ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections. With Democrats seeking control of Congress, both candidates are drawing attention for their campaigns on healthcare, affordability and education. Shah faces Republican Jay Feely, backed by Donald Trump, while Dandiya takes on Republican Casey Askar in Florida's redrawn 22nd Congressional District. Their electoral prospects highlight the growing influence of Indian-American politicians in US…
